findings.suggested_fix: In the Approach section under item 1, add a note distinguishing retry stacks: Anthropic (direct) keeps the httpx `AsyncTenacityTransport`; Bedrock uses botocore's native retry configuration (`max_attempts` in the boto3 session / `BedrockModelSettings`), wired through the Bedrock factory entry.
